name: instagram_get_message
description: One message in full: { id, created_time, from, to, message, attachments, shares }. `message` is the text. `from.id` is the Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) that instagram_send_dm and instagram_send_dm_image take as --recipient_id, and `created_time` on their latest message is what the 24-hour reply window is counted from. Only the 20 most recent messages in a conversation can be read this way.
